title: What Apple's new CEO announcement signals ahead of earnings?
title_zh: 苹果公司新任首席执行官的宣布在财报发布前预示着什么？
summary: Wall Street investors have been abuzz around Apple (AAPL) this past week after CEO Tim Cook announced his plans to depart from the chief executive role this September, handing the reins off to John Ternus.
summary_zh: 上周，苹果公司 (Apple) 首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 宣布计划于今年 9 月辞去首席执行官一职，将权力移交给约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus)，之后华尔街投资者对苹果公司 (AAPL) 议论纷纷。

title: Taiwan's Delta Electronics warns costs rising as AI data centre demand surges
title_zh: 台湾台达电子警告称，随着人工智能数据中心需求激增，成本上升
summary: Delta Electronics, a major provider of power supply and ‌cooling solutions for AI datacentres, warned that it ‌expects costs to rise in the coming quarters, with oil prices ​rising and ongoing material shortages.
summary_zh: 为人工智能数据中心提供电源和冷却解决方案的主要供应商台达电子警告称，随着油价上涨和持续的材料短缺，预计未来几个季度的成本将会上升。

title: Elon Musk to return to witness stand for cross-examination by OpenAI's lawyer
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克将返回证人席接受 OpenAI 律师的盘问
summary: By Deepa Seetharaman and Kenrick Cai OAKLAND, California, April 30 (Reuters) - Elon Musk is due to return to the witness stand on Thursday for a second day of cross-examination by Sam Altman's lawyer,
summary_zh: 作者：Deepa Seetharaman 和 Kenrick Cai 加州奥克兰，4 月 30 日（路透社）——埃隆·马斯克将于周四返回证人席，接受山姆·奥尔特曼律师的第二天盘问。

title: Google Cloud pulls ahead as Big Tech's AI bet swells to $700 billion
title_zh: 随着大型科技公司的人工智能赌注增至 7000 亿美元，谷歌云遥遥领先
summary: Alphabet's blowout cloud growth has reset expectations across major tech companies, leaving investors to recalibrate which firms are delivering the clearest returns. Alphabet shares jumped more than 6% in premarket trading on Thursday, while Meta stock fell ‌nearly 9%.
summary_zh: Alphabet 云计算的井喷式增长重新调整了主要科技公司的预期，让投资者重新调整哪些公司正在提供最明确的回报。 Alphabet 股价周四盘前交易中上涨超过 6%，而 Meta 股价下跌近 9%。

title: Samsung Electronics expects to win more customers for advanced logic chips
title_zh: 三星电子希望为先进逻辑芯片赢得更多客户
summary: SEOUL, April 30 () - Samsung Electronics said on Thursday it expects to ‌win more deals to manufacture ‌logic chips using its advanced 2 nanometer process ​in the near future, adding it has been in talks with big tech customers regarding the foundry contracts.
summary_zh: 首尔，4 月 30 日 () - 三星电子周四表示，预计在不久的将来将赢得更多使用先进 2 纳米工艺制造逻辑芯片的交易，并补充说它一直在与大型科技客户就代工合同进行谈判。

title: First Tesla Semi rolls off high volume production line
title_zh: 第一条 Tesla Semi 下线大批量生产线
summary: April 29 (Reuters) - Tesla said on Wednesday its first Semi truck has begun rolling off a high-volume production line as the electric vehicle maker remains on track to launch large-scale manufacturing
summary_zh: 路透 4 月 29 日 - 特斯拉周三表示，其第一辆 Semi 卡车已开始从大批量生产线上下线，这家电动汽车制造商仍有望启动大规模生产。

title: Highlights from Meta's earnings call
title_zh: Meta 财报电话会议的亮点
summary: Meta Platforms (META) outpaced estimates on first quarter earnings — posting a profit of $10.44 per share vs. expectations of $8.15 — while also raising its full-year capex spending forecasts to between $125 billion and $145 billion as it expects to invest more in AI.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 第一季​​度盈利超出预期——每股利润为 10.44 美元，而预期为 8.15 美元——同时还将全年资本支出预测上调至 1250 亿美元至 1450 亿美元之间，因为预计将加大对人工智能的投资。

title: Stock market today: Dow futures slide as oil surges, while Mag 7 earnings buoy tech stocks
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数期货因油价飙升而下滑，而 Mag 7 财报提振科技股
summary: The major gauges were pulled up by tech stocks, down by other industries as Mag 7 earnings dominate headlines.
summary_zh: 主要指标受到科技股的拉升，而其他行业则下跌，因为 Mag 7 的盈利占据了头条新闻。

title: Apple earnings, March PCE, Q1 GDP, mortgage rates: What to Watch
title_zh: 苹果财报、3 月份 PCE、第一季度 GDP、抵押贷款利率：关注点
summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Thursday, April 30, including earnings results from companies like Apple (AAPL), Eli Lilly (LLY), Caterpillar (CAT), and ConocoPillips (COP); the latest economic readings on the ...
summary_zh: 《寻求趋势》主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 预览了明天（4 月 30 日星期四）即将发布的几个重大新闻，其中包括苹果 (AAPL)、礼来 (LLY)、卡特彼勒 (CAT) 和康菲公司 (COP) 等公司的盈利结果；关于...的最新经济读物
